task: Typed retained live-module facts supplier contract + real implementation on pinned PS5 SDK APIs only

proposed_interface.idea: Host-injectable OS ops table + generic retained-supplier core. The SCE ops TU binds ONLY APIs whose exact signature is pinned in this workspace (dlopen/dlclose/RTLD_NOLOAD from SDK dlfcn.h; _DYNAMIC -> DT_DEBUG -> r_debug.r_map link-map walk from sys/elf64.h + sys/elf_common.h + sys/link_elf.h, because dlinfo is declared but exported by NO pinned library; sysctl KERN_PROC_PATHNAME/KERN_PROC_VMMAP from sys/sysctl.h + sys/user.h; getpid; prosperodev-pinned sceKernelGetModuleInfo + 352-byte SceKernelModuleInfo ABI; sceKernelGetModuleList declared but enumeration stays gated by the pinned unresolved byte-vs-element ABI observation). Image identity anchor = link-map walk + profile-supplied name matcher; retention = dlopen(name, RTLD_NOLOAD) loader reference released by dlclose; authoritative segments = sceKernelGetModuleInfo on a bridged handle. Exports with no pinned signature (sceKernelGetExecutableModuleHandle, FromAddr, IsModuleLoaded, GetProcessName, sceKernelVirtualQuery struct, get_module_info_list) are NOT called; they are optional ops slots plus explicit unresolved facts with designed target experiments in REPORT.md.
